data.body:
BASIC investigation complete (agent a67a). Confirmed three agent-compliance-only enforcement gaps with no hook backstop:
1. feature-request-check.py inspects INPUT language only (cannot detect that the fix itself introduces new capability because no fix code exists at gate time).
2. Phase D Step 1 'auto-approve' rules are skill text — the fix agent self-reports feature creep, which an agent framing a new helper as 'gap remediation' will not self-classify.
3. completion-verifier emits remediation_tasks_created without gap-vs-feature classification, so the orchestrator unconditionally promotes every gap into a fix-bug dispatch with no user confirmation gate.

Hook directory scan: worktree-edit-guard.sh and worktree-bash-guard.sh enforce ISOLATION; fix-bug-skill-directive.sh enforces ENTRY (Skill tool invocation); none inspect output scope (new files / new exported symbols / new PR comment markers). Confirmed by direct listing + grep.

Triggering task ddb5-be9d-45b1-4246 status: archived (matches ticket's 'closed; code being reverted' note).

Fix complexity: COMPLEX. Resolution requires:
(a) PreToolUse hook that reads active fix-bug session state and blocks Write/Edit calls creating new files / new exported symbols not present in HEAD at session start (mechanical, not agent-compliance);
(b) completion-verifier rubric update adding mandatory gap_classification on remediation_tasks_created (repair_existing vs implement_new); orchestrator must gate on repair_existing before autonomous dispatch;
(c) coordinated rollout via epic.

**Existing epic match: af26-dd5a-df6d-4f81** (P0, status:open) — 'Make forbidden-action HARD-GATEs in brainstorm/sprint/fix-bug/implementation-plan load-bearing via tool-use-time enforcement'. SC1: 'A phase-aware PreToolUse hook intercepts tool calls and blocks them when the active phase (per durable session state) forbids that tool/action class.' Directly covers proposed fix (a). Epic is tagged brainstorm:complete — preplanning pending.

The af26 SC1 scope appears focused on phase-ordering gates (e.g., 'don't Edit during Phase 1'). Bug 9778's output-scope concern (e.g., 'don't introduce new files during fix-bug regardless of phase') is adjacent but broader; verifier rubric update (b) is verifier work, not hook work, and likely needs its own SC under af26 or a sibling epic. Recommend either expanding af26's SCs during preplanning OR creating a sibling epic — user decision.

Per CLAUDE.md rule:bug-close-with-code (no code fix possible in single bug) AND ticket's own resolution path ('Address with dedicated focused work AFTER the remediation epic stabilizes the PR/review workflow'), this bug remains OPEN as a tracking record. Linking to af26 as the primary remediation home.
